observed.caption: A wind farm with multiple white turbines on a green grassy hill under a partly cloudy blue sky.
observed.description: The photo shows a green grassy hillside with scattered rocks in the foreground and a large white wind turbine on the right side. Multiple additional white wind turbines with three blades are visible along the ridge and hillside in the background. Below the ridge there is a cluster of low beige buildings with gray roofs enclosed by a fence containing electrical equipment, with several parked vehicles nearby including white and dark-colored cars and vans. Piles of gravel and stacks of large concrete pipes lie on the grass in the center foreground. A reddish-brown dirt road winds up the hill through dark green trees and shrubs. The sky above is blue with large white and gray cumulus clouds. Small human figures are visible walking on the grass and road on the lower right slope.
